blocks.text: Bog'lovchilar: and, but, or, so, because

Ikki qisqa gapni bitta gapga birlashtirish uchun **bog'lovchi** (conjunction) kerak: I was tired. I went to bed. → I was tired, **so** I went to bed. O'zbek tilida bu ish ko'pincha fe'l shakli bilan bajariladi: «Charcha**b**, uxlashga yotdim», «Charcha**ganim uchun** erta yotdim», «Charchagan **bo'lsam-da**, ishladim». Ingliz tilida fe'l o'zgarmaydi — ikki to'liq gap orasiga alohida so'z qo'yiladi. Shuning uchun har bir qismda o'z egasi va kesimi bo'ladi: I was tired — **so** — I went to bed.

rows: I washed the dishes **and** made tea.
It was late, **so** we took a taxi.
We took a taxi **because** it was late.

blocks.text: **and** ikki o'xshash fikrni yoki ketma-ket bo'lgan harakatlarni bog'laydi. O'zbekchadagi `-ib` ravishdoshi ko'pincha aynan **and** ga to'g'ri keladi: «Uyga kel**ib**, ovqat qildim» — I came home **and** cooked dinner. Ikkala qismning egasi bir xil bo'lsa, ikkinchisida ega takrorlanmaydi: I came home and (I) cooked. Uch va undan ortiq narsani sanaganda **and** faqat oxirgisidan oldin keladi: bread, cheese **and** apples. **and** har doim ham «va» deb tarjima qilinmaydi — ba'zan «esa», «ham» yoki shunchaki vergul tabiiyroq.

items.text: We had lunch **and** went for a walk by the river.
Aziz is from Bukhara **and** his wife is from Tashkent.
I need eggs, milk **and** sugar for the cake.
items.translation: Tort uchun tuxum, sut **va** shakar kerak.

blocks.text: **but** ikkinchi qism birinchisiga zid yoki kutilmagan ekanini bildiradi: «lekin», «ammo», «biroq». O'zbekchada buning uchun ko'pincha `-sa-da` yoki `-u` / `-yu` yuklamasi ishlatiladi: «Charchagan **bo'lsam-da**, ishni tugatdim» — I was tired, **but** I finished the work. Ikki to'liq gap orasida **but** dan oldin odatda vergul qo'yiladi; qisqa birikmada vergul shart emas: small **but** cosy.

items.text: The test was long, **but** it wasn't difficult.
items.translation: Test uzun edi, **lekin** qiyin emas edi.

items.text: Bekzod is rich, **but** he isn't happy.

blocks.text: **or** ikki yoki undan ko'p variantdan birini tanlashni bildiradi — «yoki». Savollarda juda ko'p ishlatiladi: Tea **or** coffee? Inkor gapda **and** emas, **or** qo'yiladi — bu o'zbekchadagi «na ... na» ga to'g'ri keladi: I don't drink tea **or** coffee — Men **na** choy, **na** qahva ichaman. Buyruq gapdan keyin **or** «bo'lmasa» ma'nosini beradi: Hurry up, **or** you'll be late — Tezroq bo'l, **bo'lmasa** kechikasan.

items.text: Do you want rice **or** potatoes with your chicken?

blocks.text: so va because — natija va sabab

Bu ikki bog'lovchi bitta voqeani ikki tomondan ko'rsatadi. **because** («chunki», «`-gani uchun`») **sababni** beradi — «Nega?» savoliga javob. **so** («shuning uchun», «shu sababli») **natijani** beradi — «Xo'sh, nima bo'ldi?» savoliga javob. Ma'no bir xil, faqat tartib teskari: so bilan avval sabab, keyin natija; because bilan avval natija, keyin sabab.

rows: It was raining, **so** we stayed at home.
Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, **shuning uchun** uyda qoldik.
We stayed at home **because** it was raining.
**Because** it was raining, we stayed at home.

blocks.text: **because** gap boshida ham kelishi mumkin — u holda ikki qism orasiga vergul qo'yiladi. **so** esa doim ikkinchi qismning boshida turadi, oldidan vergul qo'yiladi. Og'zaki nutqda «Why?» savoliga faqat **because** li qism bilan javob berish mumkin: Why are you late? — **Because** I missed the bus. Yozma matnda esa **because** li qism yolg'iz turmaydi, u asosiy gapga ulanadi.

items.text: I'm hungry **because** I didn't have breakfast.
I didn't have breakfast, **so** I'm hungry.
Why are you smiling? — **Because** I'm happy!

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «**Because** it was late, **so** we took a taxi.» → bitta bog'lovchi yetarli: **Because** it was late, we took a taxi. yoki It was late, **so** we took a taxi. (o'zbekchada «chunki ... shuning uchun» birga kela oladi, inglizchada — yo'q). «I don't like tea **and** coffee.» → inkorda **or**: I don't like tea **or** coffee. «I was tired, so went to bed.» → **so** dan keyin ega shart: so **I** went to bed.
Ikkinchi qismda ega qachon tushib qoladi?

**and**, **but** va **or** dan keyin ega birinchi qismdagi bilan bir xil bo'lsa, uni takrorlamaslik mumkin: She opened the door **and** (she) went in. **so** va **because** dan keyin esa ega doim yoziladi, chunki ular yangi to'liq gapni boshlaydi: He was ill, **so he** stayed at home. He stayed at home **because he** was ill.

rows: I got up **and** had a shower.
She called **but** didn't leave a message.
We can walk **or** take the bus.

blocks.text: Eslab qolish: **because** — «Nega?» ga javob (sabab), **so** — «Natijasi nima?» ga javob. Ikkalasini bitta gapda birga ishlatmang. **so** ning boshqa ma'nosi ham bor — «juda»: I'm **so** tired (Juda charchadim). Bu bog'lovchi emas.

Bog'lanish: vaqt bog'lovchilari **when**, **before**, **after**, **while**, **until** → 98-dars; shart bog'lovchisi **if** → 99–100-darslar. **So am I** / **Neither do I** (42-dars) dagi **so** — boshqa tuzilish.

rows: It was cold, **so** I stayed in.
I stayed in **because** it was cold.

examples.title: **and**: adding facts and actions
examples.description: **and** ikki faktni yoki ketma-ket harakatlarni bog'laydi. O'zbekchadagi «va», «ham» va ko'pincha `-ib` shakli (turib, yopib) shunga mos keladi.

sentences.text: I got up early **and** made breakfast for everyone.
sentences.translation: Erta **turib**, hammaga nonushta tayyorladim.

sentences.text: My brother lives in London **and** works in a bank.
sentences.translation: Akam Londonda yashaydi **va** bankda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: We visited Samarkand **and** Bukhara last summer.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Samarqand **va** Buxoroda bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Sarah closed her laptop **and** went to the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Sara noutbukini **yopib**, oshxonaga ketdi.

sentences.text: The hotel was clean, **and** the staff were very friendly.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona toza edi, xodimlari **ham** juda xushmuomala edi.

sentences.text: Do you want to come with us **and** see the new film?
sentences.translation: Biz bilan **borib**, yangi filmni ko'rishni xohlaysizmi?

sentences.text: Tom bought some bread, cheese **and** apples at the market.
sentences.translation: Tom bozordan non, pishloq **va** olma oldi.

sentences.text: On Sundays we clean the house **and** then visit my grandparents.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari uyni **yig'ishtirib**, keyin bobom va buvimnikiga boramiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza speaks English, **and** now she's learning German too.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ingliz tilini biladi, **ustiga** hozir nemis tilini ham o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: James finished work at five, went to the gym **and** came home at eight.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ishni beshda tugatdi, sport zaliga **bordi va** sakkizda uyga qaytdi.

examples.title: **but**: contrast
examples.description: **but** — ikkinchi qism birinchisiga zid yoki kutilmagan: «lekin», «ammo», «biroq». O'zbekchada ko'pincha `-sa-da` yoki `-u` / `-yu` bilan aytiladi.

sentences.text: The flat is small **but** very comfortable.
sentences.translation: Kvartira kichik, **lekin** juda qulay.

sentences.text: I called Bekzod three times, **but** he didn't answer.
sentences.translation: Bekzodga uch marta qo'ng'iroq qildim, **ammo** u javob bermadi.

sentences.text: My sister likes tea, **but** I prefer coffee.
sentences.translation: Singlim choyni yaxshi ko'radi, men **esa** qahvani afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: It was sunny this morning, **but** now it's raining.
sentences.translation: Ertalab quyoshli edi, **lekin** hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: Emma can swim well, **but** she can't ride a bike.
sentences.translation: Emma yaxshi suzadi, **biroq** velosiped hayday olmaydi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I'd like to help you, **but** I'm very busy today.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, yordam bergim kelardi-yu, **lekin** bugun juda bandman.

sentences.text: It was nearly midnight, **but** the shops were still open.
sentences.translation: Yarim tun bo'lib qolgan **bo'lsa-da**, do'konlar hali ochiq edi.

sentences.text: We waited for an hour, **but** the bus didn't come.
sentences.translation: Bir soat **kutdik-u**, avtobus kelmadi.

sentences.text: This phone is old, **but** it still works perfectly.
sentences.translation: Bu telefon eski, **lekin** hali ham a'lo ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Mr Brown has lived in Tashkent for ten years, **but** his Uzbek isn't very good.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun o'n yildan beri Toshkentda yashaydi, **lekin** o'zbekchasi unchalik yaxshi emas.

examples.title: **or**: choices, questions and negatives
examples.description: **or** — tanlov: «yoki». Inkor gapda **and** o'rniga **or** keladi («na ... na»), buyruq gapdan keyin esa «bo'lmasa» ma'nosini beradi.

sentences.text: Would you like tea **or** coffee?
sentences.translation: Choy ichasizmi **yoki** qahva?

sentences.text: We can go by bus **or** take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Avtobusda borishimiz **yoki** taksi chaqirishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Is your new teacher from London **or** Manchester?
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchingiz Londondanmi **yoki** Manchesterdanmi?

sentences.text: I don't eat meat **or** fish.
sentences.translation: Men **na** go'sht, **na** baliq yeyman.

sentences.text: Call me tonight **or** send me a message.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qiling **yoki** xabar yuboring.

sentences.text: Madina didn't phone **or** write to us last week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Madina bizga **na** qo'ng'iroq qildi, **na** xat yozdi.

sentences.text: Do you want to stay at home **or** go for a walk in the park?
sentences.translation: Uyda qolishni xohlaysanmi **yoki** parkda sayr qilishni?

sentences.text: Hurry up, **or** we'll miss the train!
sentences.translation: Tezroq bo'l, **bo'lmasa** poyezdga ulgurmaymiz!

sentences.text: There are two **or** three good cafés near the station.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida **ikki-uchta** yaxshi kafe bor.

sentences.text: After nine our children can't watch TV **or** play computer games.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizdan keyin bolalarimiz **na** televizor ko'ra oladi, **na** kompyuter o'yini o'ynay oladi.

examples.title: **because**: giving a reason
examples.description: **because** — sabab: «chunki», «`-gani uchun`». «Nega?» savoliga javob beradi. Gap boshida kelsa, ikki qism orasiga vergul qo'yiladi.

sentences.text: I'm tired **because** I worked all day.
sentences.translation: Charchadim, **chunki** kun bo'yi ishladim.

sentences.text: We stayed indoors **because** it was too hot outside.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida juda **issiq bo'lgani uchun** uyda o'tirdik.

sentences.text: Aziz is happy **because** he passed his driving test.
sentences.translation: Aziz xursand, **chunki** haydovchilik imtihonidan o'tdi.

sentences.text: **Because** the road was closed, we took a different way.
sentences.translation: Yo'l **yopiq bo'lgani uchun** boshqa yo'ldan bordik.

sentences.text: Sarah didn't come to the party **because** she was ill.
sentences.translation: Sara kasal **bo'lgani uchun** ziyofatga kelmadi.

sentences.text: Why are you learning English? — **Because** I want to study in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganyapsiz? — **Chunki** Oksfordda o'qimoqchiman.

sentences.text: I can't sleep **because** the neighbours are very noisy.
sentences.translation: Uxlay olmayapman, **chunki** qo'shnilar juda shovqin qilyapti.

sentences.text: The shop was closed **because** it was a holiday.
sentences.translation: Bayram **bo'lgani uchun** do'kon yopiq edi.

sentences.text: My grandmother doesn't use the lift **because** she's afraid of it.
sentences.translation: Buvim liftga chiqmaydi, **chunki** undan qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: We're leaving early tomorrow **because** our flight is at seven.
sentences.translation: Ertaga erta yo'lga chiqamiz, **chunki** reysimiz soat yettida.

examples.title: **so**: talking about the result
examples.description: **so** — natija: «shuning uchun», «shu sababli», «shu bois». Doim ikkinchi qism boshida, oldidan vergul; undan keyin ega albatta yoziladi.

sentences.text: It was cold, **so** I wore a warm coat.
sentences.translation: Havo sovuq edi, **shuning uchun** issiq palto kiydim.

sentences.text: The bus was late, **so** we took a taxi.
sentences.translation: Avtobus kechikdi, **shuning uchun** taksiga o'tirdik.

sentences.text: I didn't have any money, **so** I couldn't buy the book.
sentences.translation: Pulim yo'q edi, **shu sababli** kitobni ola olmadim.

sentences.text: Bekzod is very good at maths, **so** he wants to be an engineer.
sentences.translation: Bekzod matematikani juda yaxshi biladi, **shuning uchun** muhandis bo'lmoqchi.

sentences.text: My phone battery was dead, **so** I couldn't call you.
sentences.translation: Telefonimning quvvati tugab qolgan edi, **shuning uchun** sizga qo'ng'iroq qila olmadim.

sentences.text: The film was boring, **so** we left after half an hour.
sentences.translation: Film zerikarli edi, **shuning uchun** yarim soatdan keyin chiqib ketdik.

sentences.text: Emma lives near her office, **so** she walks to work.
sentences.translation: Emma ofisi yaqinida yashaydi, **shu bois** ishga piyoda boradi.

sentences.text: There was nothing in the fridge, **so** we ordered a pizza.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda hech narsa yo'q edi, **shuning uchun** pitsa buyurtma qildik.

sentences.text: Our train leaves at six, **so** we have to get up very early.
sentences.translation: Poyezdimiz oltida jo'naydi, **shuning uchun** juda erta turishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Madina had a terrible headache, **so** she went to bed early.
sentences.translation: Madinaning boshi qattiq og'riyotgan edi, **shu sababli** erta yotib qoldi.

examples.title: **so** or **because**? One story, two ways
examples.description: Bir xil voqea ikki xil aytiladi: sabab + **so** + natija yoki natija + **because** + sabab. Ma'no bir xil, faqat tartib teskari.

sentences.text: The tickets were expensive, **so** we didn't go to the concert.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar qimmat edi, **shuning uchun** konsertga bormadik.

sentences.text: We didn't go to the concert **because** the tickets were expensive.
sentences.translation: Konsertga bormadik, **chunki** chiptalar qimmat edi.

sentences.text: James missed the bus, **so** he was late for work.
sentences.translation: Jeyms avtobusdan qolib ketdi, **shuning uchun** ishga kechikdi.

sentences.text: James was late for work **because** he missed the bus.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ishga kechikdi, **chunki** avtobusdan qolib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: The café was full, **so** we went to another one.
sentences.translation: Kafe odamga to'la edi, **shuning uchun** boshqasiga bordik.

sentences.text: We went to another café **because** the first one was full.
sentences.translation: Boshqa kafega bordik, **chunki** birinchisi to'la edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza feels sick, **so** she isn't going to school today.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning tobi yo'q, **shu sababli** bugun maktabga bormayapti.

sentences.text: Dilnoza isn't going to school today **because** she feels sick.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bugun maktabga bormayapti, **chunki** tobi yo'q.

sentences.text: I've lost my keys, **so** I can't get into the house.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim, **shuning uchun** uyga kira olmayapman.

sentences.text: **Because** I've lost my keys, I can't get into the house.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **yo'qotib qo'yganim uchun** uyga kira olmayapman.

examples.title: Dialogue: making plans for Saturday
examples.description: Ikki do'st dam olish kunini rejalashtirmoqda: **and**, **but**, **or**, **so**, **because** jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Are you free on Saturday, **or** are you working?
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni bo'shmisan **yoki** ishlaysanmi?

sentences.text: — I'm free in the morning, **but** I have a lesson at two.
sentences.translation: — Ertalab bo'shman, **lekin** soat ikkida darsim bor.

sentences.text: — Great! Let's go to the museum **and** have lunch after that.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Muzeyga **borib**, keyin tushlik qilamiz.

sentences.text: — I'd love to, **but** the museum is closed on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: — Jonim bilan, **lekin** muzey shanba kunlari yopiq.

sentences.text: — Really? I didn't know that. **So** what can we do?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Bilmagan ekanman. **Unda** nima qilamiz?

sentences.text: — We can go to the park **or** play tennis.
sentences.translation: — Parkka borishimiz **yoki** tennis o'ynashimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: — I can't play tennis **because** I hurt my arm last week.
sentences.translation: — Tennis o'ynay olmayman, **chunki** o'tgan hafta qo'limni shikastlab oldim.

sentences.text: — Oh no! Is it OK now, **or** does it still hurt?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Hozir yaxshimi **yoki** hali ham og'riyaptimi?

sentences.text: — It's much better, **but** I don't want to play yet.
sentences.translation: — Ancha yaxshi, **lekin** hozircha o'ynagim kelmayapti.

sentences.text: — OK, the park, then. I'll bring some sandwiches, **and** you bring the tea!
sentences.translation: — Mayli, unda parkka boramiz. Men sendvich olib kelaman, sen **esa** choy olib kel!

examples.title: Mixed: **and**, **but**, **or**, **so**, **because**
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: bitta gapda ikki bog'lovchi ham kelishi mumkin, har biri o'z vazifasida — qo'shish, zidlik, tanlov, natija, sabab.

sentences.text: Bekzod wanted to buy the jacket, **but** it was too small, **so** he chose a different one.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kurtkani olmoqchi edi, **lekin** u juda kichik ekan, **shuning uchun** boshqasini tanladi.

sentences.text: Do you want to eat now **or** after the film?
sentences.translation: Hozir ovqatlanasanmi **yoki** filmdan keyinmi?

sentences.text: My parents are coming tomorrow, **so** I'm cleaning the flat today.
sentences.translation: Ertaga ota-onam keladi, **shuning uchun** bugun kvartirani yig'ishtiryapman.

sentences.text: Tom couldn't sleep **because** he drank too much coffee in the evening.
sentences.translation: Tom uxlay olmadi, **chunki** kechqurun juda ko'p qahva ichgan edi.

sentences.text: The weather was terrible **and** the roads were icy, **so** we stayed in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Havo juda yomon edi, yo'llar **ham** muz bilan qoplangan edi, **shuning uchun** Toshkentda qoldik.

sentences.text: I'm learning English **because** I need it for my job.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini o'rganyapman, **chunki** u menga ish uchun kerak.

sentences.text: Sarah is very clever, **but** she doesn't like school.
sentences.translation: Sara juda aqlli, **lekin** maktabni yoqtirmaydi.

sentences.text: You can pay by card **or** in cash — it's up to you.
sentences.translation: Karta **yoki** naqd pul bilan to'lashingiz mumkin — o'zingiz bilasiz.

sentences.text: **Because** it's Aziz's birthday, we're making a big cake **and** buying flowers.
sentences.translation: Azizning tug'ilgan kuni **bo'lgani uchun** katta tort pishiryapmiz **va** gul olyapmiz.

sentences.text: The hotel was cheap **and** clean, **but** it was very far from the centre.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona arzon **va** toza edi, **lekin** markazdan juda uzoqda edi.
